article.title: Pasiva perfectiva
article.part: Voz e infinitivo — Залог и инфинитив
article.chapter: Voz pasiva y estado resultante — Страдательный залог и результативное состояние

claims.summary: The passive perfective presents an action as completed and places emphasis on the entity that receives that action. In Russian, it frequently appears as 'быть + participio pasivo corto' formed from a perfective verb.
The participio pasivo corto agrees with the subject in gender and number, and the verb 'быть' situates the construction in past or future; in present tense, it is often omitted.
Provides examples of the passive perfective in Russian, such as 'Письмо было отправлено вчера' and 'Решение было принято комиссией'.
